replacements.La IEA proyecta que el consumo eléctrico: The IEA projects that global data-center electricity consumption will rise from 415 TWh in 2024 to between 945 and 1,260 TWh in 2030. replacements.El escenario base ya queda ligeramente p: The base scenario is already slightly above Japan's current electricity consumption; the high scenario takes the sector to a little more than 3× its 2024 level.
replacements.Equivalencia de orden anual: si mantiene: Annual order-of-magnitude equivalence: if it sustains that load 24/7, it consumes about as much electricity over a year as roughly 100,000 average homes.
replacements.Aquí la discusión deja de ser abstracta:: At this scale the discussion stops being abstract: substations, transmission lines and local permits become the immediate bottleneck.
replacements.Es la escala de los mayores proyectos en: This is the scale of the largest projects under construction. They compete not only for cheap electricity but for physical regional grid capacity.
replacements.Fuente: IEA, Energy and AI, 2025, para 4: Source: IEA, Energy and AI, 2025, for 415 / 945 / 1,260 TWh, the 1.5% share, the Japan comparison and the reference of a typical AI data center at ~100 MW; the largest facilities under construction consume around twenty times more.
